project_type: npm workspaces monorepo: packages/backend (Express + TypeScript + Prisma + PostgreSQL) + packages/frontend (React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind + Leaflet)
build_system: npm workspaces. Root: `npm run build` → builds backend then frontend. Backend: `tsc`. Frontend: `tsc && vite build`. No esbuild.
test_framework: Vitest 1.3.1 in both packages. Backend uses supertest for route tests. Frontend uses @testing-library/react + jsdom.
build_command: npm run build (root) — or cd packages/backend && npm run build, cd packages/frontend && npm run build individually
test_command: npm test (root, runs both) — or cd packages/backend && npm test, cd packages/frontend && npm test individually
verification_instructions: 1. cd packages/backend && npm test (16 passing). 2. cd packages/frontend && npm test (17 passing). 3. npm run build (root). 4. npm run lint (root). After Prisma schema changes: cd packages/backend && npx prisma migrate dev --name <name>. Never run prisma migrate reset or prisma db push --force-reset.
snapshot_or_generated_files: packages/backend/prisma/migrations/ — migration files are checked into git and must never be deleted. Prisma client is generated into node_modules/.prisma (not checked in). Run `cd packages/backend && npx prisma generate` to regenerate.
environment_constraints: Local PostgreSQL (Homebrew) on port 5432, database `routesy`, user/password `routesy`. DATABASE_URL=postgresql://routesy:routesy@localhost:5432/routesy. JWT_SECRET must be set. NEVER run `prisma migrate reset` or `prisma db push --force-reset`. NEVER delete migration files from packages/backend/prisma/migrations/. Only one migration folder currently: 20261009084453_init.
contribution_requirements: Keep all 33 tests passing (16 backend, 17 frontend). No new packages outside the existing stack (no Redux, Zustand, Axios). Tailwind for all styling. Lucide icons only. Do NOT rewrite working pages unless fixing a reported issue. All Prisma changes use `prisma migrate dev`. Each commit leaves the codebase buildable.
key_patterns: Backend routes return { success: true, data: ... } via sendSuccess(res, data, statusCode?) and sendError(res, message, statusCode). Ownership checked by `isOwner(trip, userId, sessionId)` — currently duplicated in trips.ts, stops.ts, sharing.ts, route.ts. Frontend uses `api.get/post/put/patch/del` from src/utils/api.ts which auto-injects X-Session-Id and Bearer token headers. SESSION_ID_KEY='routesy-session-id', TOKEN_KEY='routesy-token' are in api.ts but SESSION_ID_KEY is not exported. React.lazy + Suspense for all page components in router/index.tsx. useTrip fetches /api/trips/:id (returns Trip with stops[] and routeCache). useStops ALSO fetches /api/trips/:id (duplicate). useRoute starts null and only gets data on explicit calculate/optimize call. SearchCombobox is the existing geocoding autocomplete UI component. StopList uses HTML5 drag-and-drop. Tailwind dark mode is class-based.
directory_structure: Root: npm workspaces. packages/backend/src/routes/ — auth, trips, stops, route, sharing, geocoding, publicShare. packages/backend/src/services/ — GeocodingService, RoutingService, ShareService. packages/backend/src/middleware/ — auth, rateLimiter, errorHandler. packages/backend/src/validators/ — tripValidators, stopValidators, authValidators. packages/backend/src/utils/ — navigationUrl (UNUSED in backend), responseHelpers, ownership.ts (TO CREATE). packages/backend/prisma/ — schema.prisma, migrations/. packages/frontend/src/pages/ — Landing, Trips, NewTrip, TripPlanner, TripNavigate, Settings, ShareView (Login and Register TO CREATE, Explore TO CREATE). packages/frontend/src/components/ui/ — Button, Input, Dialog, SearchCombobox, Badge, Card, ErrorMessage, LoadingSkeleton, ProgressBar, BottomSheet. packages/frontend/src/components/trip/ — StopCard, StopList, RouteStats, ShareModal. packages/frontend/src/components/map/ — MapContainer, NumberedMarker, RoutePolyline. packages/frontend/src/hooks/ — useTrip, useStops (redundant fetch), useRoute (no cache init), useGeocoding, useShare (unused). packages/frontend/src/utils/ — api.ts (SESSION_ID_KEY not exported), cn.ts, navigationUrl.ts.
